data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior-year reserves strengthened materially in 2016 (approx. GBP 23.23m, c.62% of opening gross claims reserves), driven by adverse development in the liability book. Management noted unfavourable actual vs expected claims experience during 2016, revised development patterns and prior loss assumptions, and booked additional IBNR. Specific large liability claims (including an Australian claim and a serious sporting accident) contributed to the deterioration across 2011-2014 underwriting years.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 38). No explicit single-line gross 'movement in prior year provision' figure was found; therefore PYD was computed by comparing current cumulative estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2011-2014 (excluded '2010 & prior' aggregate and excluded 2015/2016). Figures in the triangle are reported in GBP '000; conversions to millions performed. Some table formatting in the PDF text extraction required interpretation of which numbers were cumulative claims, cumulative payments and outstanding reserves. If a gross movement note exists elsewhere, it was not explicit; triangle-derived PYD used per extraction rules.
